g.text: Separating event frequency from the cost of each interference

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596779

g.text: Left: mean paired percentage over all five repeats; shading = sample SD. Right: mean ± sample SD over eventful repeats.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596779

g.text: Per-event cost = 127 × (treatment TPOT − matched baseline TPOT) / actual events, per background request; not isolated prefill/GPU time.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596779

g.text: Zero-event repeats excluded only on the right; n=1 has no SD. Whole-output noise and negative residuals are retained; right panels use different y scales.
